CustomObject.description: One record per member per board per fiscal year within a Board Term — captures what the member did that specific year (role, whether it counts toward the 6-year limit, board-meeting attendance, and the year's giving summary). Enables point-in-time rosters and the by-fiscal-year history the client keeps (importable from eTapestry). Master-detail child of Board Term. JSI-123 Board Tracking. Author: Jason Ott.
